dslRule:
<!id: junit.assertThrows.lambdaToMethodRef>
<!description: Replace no-argument lambda with method reference in JUnit Assert.assertThrows if calling a no-argument method.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.junit.Assert.assertThrows($exceptionType, () -> $receiver.$method())
=>
org.junit.Assert.assertThrows($exceptionType, $receiver::$method)
;;
summary: Replace no-argument lambda with method reference in JUnit Assert.assertThrows for simple method calls.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
